title: Design-Build Renovation of Building 164, Outdoor Recreation Center, Homestead Air Reserve Base, Florida
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE RESERVE COMMAND > FA6648  482 LSS LGC
description:
The Department of the Air Force intends to award a firm-fixed-price design-build construction contract for renovation of the Outdoor Recreation Facility, Building 164, at Homestead Air Reserve Base, Florida. 
 
IAW DAFMAN 64-119, NAF Contracting Procedures, Small Business programs do not apply to NAF Contracting actions.  This is a non-appropriated fund purchase, and it does not obligate appropriated funds of the Unites States Government. Non-appropriated funds are generated by the military community through the sale of goods and services and the collection of fees and charges for participation in military community programs. This purchase does not involve federal tax dollars. IAW DAFMAN 64-119, NAF Contracting Procedures, Para 2.8 NAF Procurement Exemptions, Title 15 U.S.C. Section 631 et seq., also known as the Small Business Act, as amended, and Federal Acquisition Regulation guidance relative to small business along with other award-preference programs. NAF contracts are awarded to the firm whose proposal is most advantageous to the NAFI. 

 The Contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, transportation, design and engineering services, tools, permits, testing, inspections, quality control, warranties, and closeout documentation necessary to complete the work in accordance with the solicitation, Statement of Work, drawings, specifications, and all attachments. 

 The requirement includes design-build services for renovation and improvement of Building 164. Work includes, but is not limited to, preparation of design documents; demolition; roofing and exterior-envelope improvements; doors, windows, exterior walls, and drainage work; interior renovations; mechanical, plumbing, electrical, and lighting work; site improvements; testing; inspections; warranties; and closeout documentation. 

 The solicitation will include a base requirement consisting of Phases 1 and 2 and a separately priced Option 1 for Phase 3. The specific requirements for the base requirement and Option 1 are identified in Section B and the Statement of Work. 

 NAICS Code: 236220 – Commercial and Institutional Building Construction 
Size Standard: $45.0 Million Average Annual Receipts 
PSC: Y1JZ – Construction of Miscellaneous Buildings 

 Place of Performance: 
Homestead Air Reserve Base 
Building 164 
Homestead, Florida 

 Contract Type: 
Firm-Fixed-Price, Design-Build Construction 

 Magnitude of Construction: 
Between $250,000 and $500,000 

 Period of Performance: 
360 calendar days after issuance of the Notice to Proceed. 

 SITE VISIT: 
A site visit will be held on 10 November 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Attendance is strongly encouraged but is not mandatory. 

 Offerors planning to attend shall submit the completed base-access form no later than 5 November 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. At this time, Homestead Air Reserve Base is processing site-visit access requests for United States citizens only. 

 Site-visit directions have been posted to this posting. Offerors that do not attend the site visit remain responsible for becoming familiar with existing conditions, site access restrictions, facility operations, utility conditions, material-staging limitations, and all other conditions that may affect performance. 
 
Google Maps Link: https://maps.app.goo.gl/ivLWZZMdBPCdnQMU7 

 Sign In Sheet for the site visit conducted on 11/10/26 has been posted as attachment to this posting.  

 Due to access issues, there will be a second site visit scheduled for 11/17/26 at 10 AM. All terms and conditions explained above will apply to this site visit as well.  

 QUESTIONS: 
Questions concerning this solicitation shall be submitted in writing to Tahj Guilford at tahj.guilford.2@us.af.mil no later than 13 November 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Questions received after the stated deadline may not be answered. 

 The Government anticipates posting responses to timely submitted questions on or about 18 November 2026 at 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time. 

 PROPOSAL SUBMISSION: 
Offerors shall submit proposals electronically to tahj.guilford.2@us.af.mil no later than 23 November 2026 at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time. 

 Proposals shall be submitted in the format required by Sections L and M of the solicitation. Offerors are responsible for ensuring proposals are received by the Government before the closing date and time. 

 The Government intends to make award without discussions but reserves the right to conduct discussions if determined to be in the Government’s best interest. 

 All amendments to this solicitation will be posted through SAM.gov. Offerors are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov for amendments and acknowledging all amendments with their proposal. 

 The full solicitation package, including the SF 1442, Statement of Work, pricing schedule, drawings, specifications, wage determination, and other attachments, are available with this notice.
